objective: The bug button is on every screen, including full pages that unmount the map.
userOutcome: A member can report a bug from Rewards, Profile edit, Spot detail and every other full page on mobile, not only from screens that sit over the map.
successCriteria: A slot whose screen has unmounted is dropped from the registry and the button is told.
The button re-reads its slot on every route change.
On /rewards at 412px the button is in the document, in the fixed corner, visible.
mustPreserve: The docked placement on screens that register a slot.
The fixed top-right corner everywhere else.
The button's size and look on every screen.
nonGoals: No change to which screens register a slot.

assumptions.statement: React handing the ref null is the moment a slot's screen tears down; sweeping detached slots one tick later is correct.
assumptions.impact: The button leaves a dead node within a tick of the screen going.

nextVisibleMilestone: Bug button visible on Rewards on cruush.app.
stopConditions: Stop if the server build fails.
